# RegisterMySite.com

> Web development agency that builds a complete multi-platform online presence for businesses. We connect your website, Google Business Profile, Yelp, Facebook, Instagram and other listings into one professional brand so customers find a coherent presence instead of scattered or unclaimed profiles. Services include domain & DNS setup, technical + local SEO, conversion-focused websites and templates, professional business email with auto-reply workers, QR/barcode tools, analytics dashboards, and in-house custom development. Clients own the code and data. In-person support available in Los Angeles & Orange County; remote clients fully supported.

## Homepage — https://registermysite.com/

RegisterMySite.com helps businesses move from scattered listings to a fully connected online presence.

**Core value proposition**  
Multi-platform presence that ties your website, Google Business, Yelp, and social profiles together — so customers find a professional brand, not scattered listings.

**Everything Your Business Needs Online**  
From domain setup to SEO-powered websites and professional email — we handle the technical side so you can focus on customers.

### Domain & DNS Setup  
We register or connect your domain, configure DNS records correctly, and make sure everything points to your new site with zero downtime.

### SEO Optimization  
Technical SEO, schema markup, local SEO, and strategic linking of all your platform profiles so Google ranks your business higher.

### Web Design & Templates  
Beautiful, conversion-focused designs and ready-to-use industry templates. Fully responsive and mobile-first for every device.

### Custom Business Email  
Professional email addresses (@yourbusiness.com) with auto-reply workers that respond instantly while you’re busy with customers.

**How It Works (4 steps)**  
1. **Audit Your Listings** — We find every unclaimed or disconnected profile for your business across major platforms.  
2. **Build Your Website** — Choose a template or go custom. We create a site that showcases your business and services.  
3. **Claim & Link Everything** — We claim your Yelp, Google Business, and other accounts and link them back to your new website.  
4. **Launch & Rank** — DNS, SEO, emails, and analytics go live. Your business becomes discoverable and professional.

**Built for Developers & Businesses**  
- **Templates** — Dozens of industry-ready website templates (restaurants, salons, contractors, clinics, etc.).  
- **API** — Programmatically manage domains, DNS, listings, and site deployments. Ideal for agencies managing multiple client sites.  
- **Docs** — Clear documentation for DNS, email workers, SEO best practices, and third-party platform integration.  
- **In-person in LA & OC** — Service calls across Los Angeles and Orange County (discovery meetings, design reviews, staff training, on-site help). Remote clients fully supported online.  
- **You own the code & data** — Built in-house. Source, assets, and deploy config are yours — not locked inside a page builder you rent forever.

Contact: hello@registermysite.com or sales@registermysite.com

Custom enterprise packages available.

## Documentation — https://registermysite.com/docs

**How to Register a Domain & Build Your Website**

1. Go to Domain Search tool: https://registermysite.com/tools/Domain_Search  
2. Check domain availability across popular TLDs (.com, .net, .org, .io, .dev, .app, etc.). View WHOIS for taken domains.  
3. Submit registration (registrant contact info, period, payment if required). WHOIS privacy is usually included free.  
4. Complete registration and receive confirmation email.  
5. Create / log in to your RegisterMySite account.  
6. Collaborate with the team: select templates, share brand assets & content, review staging previews, request revisions.  
7. Launch: site is connected to your domain, DNS & SSL handled, ongoing updates available via dashboard.

Additional notes:  
- If a desired domain is taken, try alternative spellings, different TLDs, or short keywords.  
- Contact sales@registermysite.com for help with registration, account setup, or website collaboration.

## API Reference — https://registermysite.com/api

Base URL: https://registermysite.com  
Format: JSON  
Auth: Session cookie or Bearer token where noted  
Infrastructure: Cloudflare Workers, D1 (users), KV (OAuth state), Durable Objects (sessions). Deployed with wrangler. Clients own the project code and data bindings.

**Authentication**  
- GET /api/auth/google — Start Google OAuth  
- GET /api/auth/github — Start GitHub OAuth  
- GET /api/auth/callback/google & /api/auth/callback/github — OAuth callbacks, create/find user, set session cookie, redirect to /dashboard  
- GET /api/auth/me — Current user from session (401 if logged out)  
- POST /api/auth/logout — Destroy session and clear cookie  

**Dashboard**  
- GET /api/dashboard — Protected. Returns welcome payload and user profile  

**Checkout & billing**  
- POST /api/checkout/create-subscription  
  Body: plan ("starter" | "growth" | "pro"), firstName, lastName, email, company (optional), country, postal  
  Plans: starter $49/mo, growth $129/mo, pro $299/mo  

**Domain & tools**  
Interactive domain search and WHOIS primarily in the Domain Search UI. Server-side registration handoff via GET /register?domain={name}. Additional tools under /tools/.

**System**  
- GET /api/health — Liveness check  

Error codes: 400 (bad params), 401 (unauthenticated), 403 (forbidden), 404 (not found), 500 (server error).

Custom endpoints for domains, billing webhooks, or client dashboards can be implemented in-house with source handoff.

## Domain Search Tool — https://registermysite.com/tools/Domain_Search
